show: I Said No Gifts! A comedy interview podcast with Bridger Winegar

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Actor John Gemberling brings a surprise painting gift and discusses food habits.
kurzfassung: John Gemberling joins the podcast to talk about his eating habits, childhood art created by his father, and strange delivery habits. The guest brings a personalized painting as an unexpected gift, leading to discussions about movies and unconventional party guest lists. They also answer a listener question with recommendations for a 30th birthday present.
stichpunkte: John Gemberling prefers eating alone at home with private deliveries while avoiding restaurants.
Gemberling's father, Stephen, painted numerous portraits of him as Greek gods and cherubs during his childhood.
The guest brings an unexpected painting of John as Poseidon as a gift, despite the podcast's premise.
Both discuss their frustration with unnecessary theatrical formats like IMAX and the absurdity of hype-driven restaurants.
Gemberling shares his recent DIY experience of buying a toilet snake on Amazon to fix a plumbing issue.
During a promotional break, Gemberling mentions switching to AT&T fiber internet and upcoming voice acting roles.
The host and guest compile an eccentric celebrity party guest list including Keanu Reeves and Roseanne Barr.
They answer a listener's birthday question by suggesting a Gundam robot model kit as the ultimate gift.

clips.hook: Whispering through the curtains for food deliveries
clips.text: The guest discusses the habit of dining alone at restaurants like Clark Street Diner while reading books.

clips.hook: Growing up as an artist father's primary muse
clips.text: John Gemberling examines a custom-painted gift from his father, Stephen, which depicts figures resembling Greek deities.

clips.hook: Trapped in the third row of an IMAX theater
clips.text: The pair discusses a painting acquired in Palm Springs that bears a striking, unintentional resemblance to Gemberling.

clips.hook: Switching to AT&T fiber optic internet
clips.text: A household plumbing mishap occurred after a bleach tablet became lodged in the toilet, forcing a temporary ban on its use.

clips.hook: Automatic doors and the modern carbon footprint
clips.text: The host and guest debate the length of a celebrity list, specifically questioning whether Jodie Foster should remain on it.

beschreibung:
Bridger lets it slide when John Gemberling (Broad City, Making History) makes the mistake of arriving with a gift. The two discuss fruit in coffee, Gundam accessories, and oven temperatures.
Don't forget to review the podcast, it's the least you can do.
